name: @ostomy/core
description: Shared kernel: two-tier validation, canonical unit conversion, Daily Net Fluid Balance classification, and the i18n catalog. Consumed by apps/api and both patient clients (ADR-0007).
//exports: No root '.' export on purpose (ADR-0007): validation, units, hydration and i18n are this sprint's four owned, independent entry points. fhir-data-modeler and nestjs-api-developer add their own subpaths (./fhir, ./sync) when their sprints land; ./api-client is generated. A root barrel is deliberately not introduced yet — see packages/config/eslint/index.js's admin-boundary comment on why an all-encompassing '@ostomy/core' specifier is exactly the thing to avoid reintroducing casually.
